errors.text_span: 其终点的纵坐标值约为3
errors.evidence: The description claims the endpoint of the red curve has a y-value of approximately 3. However, the image shows the curve extending to the right edge of the plot, where its y-value is closer to 2. The value is approximately 3 at the x-position corresponding to the '2^10' bar, but this is not the endpoint of the curve.
